headline: Come in.
headlineAccent: This is where it all gathers.
intro: Clifford Waldman is a songwriter, clinical psychologist, writer and teacher. This is his home online, where the music, the ideas and the people all come together.
subline: Music and lyrics, writing, clinical psychology, Torah and spiritual reflection, workshops, and a growing community, all under one roof.

rooms.title: Music & creative work
rooms.text: Songwriting at the heart of it: songs with their lyrics shown beside the music, and the Lollipop Cruise universe.

rooms.title: Psychology
rooms.text: A clinical practice, described plainly: the professional side of the work, and a private way to get in touch.

rooms.title: Spirituality & teaching
rooms.text: Torah thoughts and reflections on faith and growth, alongside workshops and lectures.

gatheringText: Music, psychology and faith all grow richer in conversation. This is a place for that conversation to happen.
